principle: A production browsing tool NEVER gives up at the first wall — it CLIMBS this ladder of methods until one works or every rung is exhausted, then reports honestly WHICH rungs it tried + which need wiring. Each rung is cheaper-but-weaker below, costlier-but-stronger above; the descent tries the cheapest that gets the content within guardrails. Methods reference real entries in web_browsing_stack_registry (browsers + driving_components). Evasion rungs are GOVERNED by research_guardrail_policy (honor robots/ToS, refuse login-walled hosts) — cataloged != unconditionally used. serves_truth=false.
policy: exhaust every WIRED rung before concluding unavailable; on exhaustion, name the next cataloged rung. Never silently stop at rung 1.
